items.title: Alliant Energy (LNT) Stock Price Faces A Q3 Earnings Puzzle
items.summary: Alliant Energy just turned in its Q3 2026 scorecard with earnings per share of about US$1.53 and the stock barely flinched. Shares were up only 1.4% to US$71.65 into the first full trading day after the release, a calm move for a utility quietly posting a strong profit season. The real story sits in the earnings power underneath that smooth price line. Net income of roughly US$398 million and a trailing net margin of 20.7% paint a sturdier picture than the modest one day gain suggests. Short...
